{"status":"OK","messages":[{"level":"info","content":"Creating wordfreq.mjs and test/wordfreq.test.mjs"}],"files":[{"path":"wordfreq.mjs","content":"#!/usr/bin/env node\n\"use strict\";\nimport { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { exit, argv } from 'node:process';\n\n// Helper to parse command line options\nfunction parseArgs(args) {\n  const opts = { top: 10, file: null };\n  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {\n    const arg = args[i];\n    if (arg === '--top' || arg === '-t') {\n      const val = args[++i];\n      if (!val || isNaN(Number(val))) {\n        console.error('Error: --top requires a numeric value');\n        exit(1);\n      }\n      opts.top = Number(val);\n    } else if (!arg.startsWith('-')) {\n      opts.file = arg;\n    }\n  }\n  if (!opts.file) {\n    console.error('Usage: wordfreq <file> [--top N]');\n    exit(1);\n  }\n  return opts;\n}\n\nfunction tokenize(text) {\n  // Split on any non‑word character, convert to lower case\n  return text\n    .toLowerCase()\n    .split(/\\W+/)\n    .filter(Boolean);\n}\n\nfunction countWords(words) {\n  const map = new Map();\n  for (const w of words) {\n    map.set(w, (map.get(w) ?? 0) + 1);\n  }\n  return map;\n}\n\nfunction sortCounts(map) {\n  const arr = Array.from(map.entries());\n  arr.sort((a, b) => {\n    const diff = b[1] - a[1];\n    if (diff !== 0) return diff;\n    return a[0].localeCompare(b[0]);\n  });\n  return arr;\n}\n\nfunction main() {\n  const opts = parseArgs(argv.slice(2));\n  let data;\n  try {\n    data = readFileSync(opts.file, 'utf8');\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.error(`Error reading file: ${opts.file}`);\n    exit(1);\n  }\n\n  const words = tokenize(data);\n  const counts = countWords(words);\n  const sorted = sortCounts(counts).slice(0, opts.top);\n\n  for (const [word, count] of sorted) {\n    console.log(`${word} ${count}`);\n  }\n}\n\nif (import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) {\n  main();\n}\n"},"{"path":"test/wordfreq.test.mjs","content":"import assert from 'node:assert';\nimport { describe, it } from 'node:test';\nimport { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';\n\n// Import the functions we want to test (they are exported for testing)\nimport { tokenize, countWords, sortCounts } from '../wordfreq.mjs';\n\ndescribe('tokenize', () => {\n  it('splits on punctuation and lowercases', () => {\n    const input = 'Hello, world! This is a test. Hello?';\n    const expected = ['hello', 'world', 'this', 'is', 'a', 'test', 'hello'];\n    assert.deepStrictEqual(tokenize(input), expected);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('countWords', () => {\n  it('counts correctly', () => {\n    const words = ['a', 'b', 'a', 'c'];\n    const result = countWords(words);\n    assert.strictEqual(result.get('a'), 2);\n    assert.strictEqual(result.get('b'), 1);\n    assert.strictEqual(result.get('c'), 1);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('sortCounts', () => {\n  it('sorts by count desc then alphabetically', () => {\n    const map = new Map([\n      ['b', 2],\n      ['a', 3],\n      ['c', 2],\n    ]);\n    const sorted = sortCounts(map);\n    assert.deepStrictEqual(sorted, [\n      ['a', 3],\n      ['b', 2],\n      ['c', 2],\n    ]);\n  });\n});\n"}]}
